senses.gloss: (= centuria) [a number of acres of ground,] large court.
units: Tosef. B. Bath. VI, 24 ק׳ אני מוכר וכ׳ if a man says, I sell thee a centenar, he must deliver to him an area of twelve (cubits) by twelve; B. Bath. 98ᵇ קנתיר (Ms. M. קנתור; Ms. H. קנתינר; Ms. R. קנטינר); expl.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 98b:10">ib.</cite> <he>תרבץ אפדני</he> court for a villa.

senses.gloss: a hundred thousand sesterces, a weight corresp. to h. כִּכָּר; (abbrev.) קִנְטֵיר, קִנְטֵר, קִנְטְרָא, קִי׳.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 25:39">Targ. Y. Ex. XXV, 39</cite> <cite ref="S01557"><he>קנטנר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 37:24">Ib. XXXVII, 24</cite> <cite ref="S01557"><he>קנטינר</he></cite> (Ar. <he>קנטר</he>).
<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 20:2">Targ. I Chr. XX, 2</cite> <he>קנטר</he>, <cite ref="S01557"><he>קנטינר</he></cite> ed. Lag. (ed. Rahmer <he>קנטיניר</he>, Var. <he>קנטר</he>).
<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 23:11">Targ. II Chr. XXIII, 11</cite>; a. e.—
Bekh. 50ᵃ איכא … לקינטרא תיקלא there is a place where the centenarium is called tikla; B. Mets. 87ᵃ לקנטירא.—Pl. קִנְטִינָרִין, קִנְטֵירִין, קִינְטְרִין, קִנְטְרֵי, קִנְטְרַיָּא, קַ׳, קִי׳.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 38:24">Targ. Y. Ex. XXXVIII, 24</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 38:25">25</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 38:27">27</cite>.

Targ. I Chr. XIX, 6; a. e.—Bekh. l. c. כל כסף … דכתובין ק׳ וכ׳ wherever ‘silver’ is mentioned in the Pentateuch, it means Sela, in the Prophets, litrae, in the Hagiographa, centenaria, except the silver mentioned in the transaction of Ephron (Gen. XXIII) where it means centenaria; B. Mets. l. c. דלא שקל מיניה אלא ק׳ (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 70) he (Ephron) would not accept anything of him (Abraham) but centenaria; Yalk. Gen. 102; Gen. R. s. 58 קונ׳.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 42">Ex. R. s. 42</cite>, v. <cite ref="M01940"><he>מֶסֶךְ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:6">Lev. R. s. 28</cite> <he>עשרת … ק׳ דכספא</he> the ten thousand hundredweights of silver (<cite ref="Esther 3:9">Esth. III, 9</cite>).
Ib. בעשרה ק׳ worth ten centenaria; Pesik. Haʿomer, p. 71ᵇ; a. e.
